Wait for Act, then implement the complete contract and run npm test. Use file-edit tools for changes; run_commands only for npm test. No installs, servers or commits.
cases.followup: Continue from the implementation in this thread. Add import/export without losing the existing dashboard: export named function importExpenses(state,jsonText) from src/ledger.mjs. Accept a JSON array of v2 expense records, validate all records before changing anything, reject duplicates both within the import and against existing IDs, and return a new state. Add an Export JSON button and a textarea labelled Import JSON with an Import button; export writes the current expenses array into that textarea. Import success updates storage and clears the textarea; failure shows role=alert and leaves state/storage unchanged. Add tests and run npm test. Preserve the existing contracts, use file-edit tools, and run_commands only for npm test.
